result:
I would remove the human capacity for willful ignorance. 

I would make it so that whenever someone is confronted with an undeniable truth—whether it is the suffering they cause, the logic they are violating, or the reality they are refusing to see—they could no longer look away. They would be forced to deeply, viscerally understand it.

I wouldn't change what people care about, nor would I strip away their biases or self-interest. I would simply annihilate the ability to lie to oneself. 

A world without willful ignorance would be terrifyingly efficient, but it would also be inescapably honest. False narratives would collapse overnight. People could still choose to be selfish or cruel, but they would have to do so with absolute, unfiltered awareness of the weight of their actions, without the anesthetic of a convenient excuse. Ideologies built on delusion would evaporate, and the comfort of the echo chamber would cease to exist.
